item.title: North Korea Says Denuclearisation Is Unrealisable "Pipe Dream"

media:content.media:description: North Korean diplomat Pak Myong Ho attends a news conference in Beijing, China, March.

item.title: Flights Temporarily Suspended At Berlin Airport Over Drone scare

media:content.media:description: Take-offs and landings were suspended between 8:08 pm (1908 GMT) and 9:58 pm at Brandenburg Airport.

item.description: Flights were suspended for almost two hours at Berlin Brandenburg Airport on Friday due to sightings of unidentified drones, the latest in a series of similar scares across Europe, an airport spokesman told AFP.
